title: Transfer the Love

source.title: Trump 'couldn't transfer the love' of his supporters to other Republicans amid historic midterm loss
source.note: published 11-04 14:30 EST; the page's HTML title is the dek's story — 'Trump admits Iran war likely cost Republicans the midterm elections'. The 11-04 sweep matched it on 'gasoline', 'iran', 'midterm'. Read in full via the cloud fetch (the .print page) as paragraph reductions, no quotation over ten words. Eighteen paragraphs: the article (McGreevy) and the reporters' questions; the holder live, taking questions at the ballroom's final-beam ceremony the day after the vote; the vice-president's X post as reported. Chosen as the newest Fox page on a live object (H1c — the holder's own accounting of the pump and the vote); my call

object.label: H1 — the Russian diesel deal (PG01 layer 1): the price leg (H1c) read by the vote — the day after Democrats took the House and Senate, the holder's own accounting, live and unscripted, of what the war did to the pump and the pump to the vote: 'largely true' that the war cost the election; the war 'drove the gasoline up a little bit short term'; 'I thought oil would rise much more'; 'you have no choice'; 'if I had to do it again I would'. The vice-president's post the same morning: 'the reason we lost is the war'; first order of business, end it. The deal, Russia, the cargo and the Strait are not on the page; the pump is on it only as 'the gasoline', unnumbered

zAxis.pos: prices came down by the deal before the vote, and the vote was not the pump's verdict
zAxis.neg: they did not — the holder concedes the war 'drove the gasoline up' and the vote followed; the vice-president says the war is why

transformNote: the shadow is the holder's promise — diesel 'COMING DOWN, IN RECORD NUMBERS, AND FAST' (10-11), 'soon' (10-24), 'really fast' (10-29), 'not very high' (ds 11-01), the office's 'once this conflict comes to an end' (11-02). On this page the holder, asked the day after, concedes the price rose — with two vehicles folded into the concession ('a little bit', 'short term') — and sizes it against his own forecast: he 'thought oil would rise much more'. The cure's horizon moves again, to 'long term' and 'the only answer'. The vote is explained as love that could not be transferred; the vice-president explains it as the war

lines.quote: Trump 'couldn't transfer the love' of his supporters to other Republicans amid historic midterm loss; the dek: he acknowledged the Iran war likely cost Republicans but insisted he had no choice to prevent a nuclear weapon
lines.note: THE DOOR (hed + dek): the vehicle is the holder's own ('love'); the dek carries the concession and its justification in one breath
lines.zWhy: a loss conceded to the war is the price's verdict, in the holder's words

lines.quote: his first public appearance after Democrats captured the House and Senate in Tuesday's midterms
lines.note: the frame: the day after; the vote already in
lines.zWhy: the day after a sweep is the vote already counted against the price

lines.quote: if I were on the ballot, we would have won — thousands and thousands at every rally
lines.note: constitutive — THE HOLDER'S FIRST READING OF THE VOTE: turnout and himself, not the price. Not Dia-scored

lines.quote: you couldn't transfer that love — there was such love at those rallies — to candidates
lines.note: constitutive — THE VEHICLE: the vote explained as love not transferred; the headline's phrase. Not Dia-scored
